regions.merged_text: Mrs. Catherine Foley - 59 - asks prayers for her twin sons - they were just a month old when their father went away to the W. War No. 1 and just a year old when he was killed in service. Now the one is in Cleveland hospital from shrapnel wound received in France last June - Expecting serious operation shortly. The other twin is on way overseas to Germany.
